QuestInfo.name: Bruce's Cooking Ingredients
QuestInfo.0: #p206# in #m10001000# is curious about what advice #p203# gave.
QuestInfo.1: It seems #p206# in #m10001000# needs ingredients to make a dish according to #t4031111#. You need to bring him the ingredients by defeating monsters or buying them from the town's general store.\r\n#rOnly characters at Level 17 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I brought #p206# in #m10001000# the ingredients to finish the dish for his daughter. Now all I can do is hope he finishes cooking it well.

0.0: I’ve never cooked something this grand before, so I’m not very confident, but for my daughter whom I’ve found after 7 long years, there’s nothing I wouldn’t do! But, you see... I’m hopelessly short on ingredients. Could you lend me a hand?

yes.0: Thank you! Let’s see here... Looking at this recipe, it seems to be for a sweet fruit cake. I’ll need #b3 #t2010002#s, 3 #t2010001#s, and 3 #t2010004#s#k sold at the general store in this town. And for the cooking itself, I’d appreciate it if you could also gather about #b15 #t4000015#s#k. According to my research, #t4000015#s can be obtained by defeating #o15# monsters found in the #m10001000# or #m10003000# areas. I’m counting on you!

no.0: I see... But some of these ingredients seem completely beyond my reach to get on my own. Please help me out later when you have some time.

1.0: Ah, you’re back! Let’s see... It looks like you’ve brought all the ingredients I asked for! Now all that’s left is for me to do my best and put my heart into this dish.

item.0: Ah, you’re back! But it doesn’t look like you’ve gathered all the ingredients I asked for yet?
